owner_rules: city name required on every thumbnail
real source-backed city photos/maps/documents required when available
weak topics must be rejected before rendering
random arrows, random center lines, filler labels, decorative boxes, and unexplained black boxes are hard blocks
main title fonts must feel premium, bold, condensed, high-contrast, and phone-readable
thumbnails should create a mysterious, click-worthy question that the first 30 seconds pays off
liked thumbnail formats can be saved for A/B tests, but unique topics must not blindly reuse one template
owner-provided reference screenshots show the target energy: vivid colors, sexy premium fonts, stunning city images, human stakes, huge city anchors, and shelf-readable high contrast
bare redaction bars with barely any readable words are a hard block
public-facing filler labels like SOURCE PHOTO, RECEIPT, and SOURCE FILE are hard blocks unless they are the actual curiosity hook and visually worth clicking
blue/cyan overlays must not look generic or bland; use vivid color systems with clear contrast and topic purpose
bland thumbnails fail even when technically source-backed; click desire is a required gate

the owner rated the recent Cleveland vivid city-and-proof examples 98/100; preserve their bright blue and warm-gold energy, clean poster depth, strong negative space, and premium text hierarchy as an approved reference direction
for a time-contrast story, use an actual old photo beside a current/source-safe city image; do not use a map as the old-photo substitute
a city name should be the largest or co-largest element whenever city recognition is the main search-shelf hook

liked_formats.owner_basis: Owner liked redacted/source-file curiosity when words and redactions are intentional.
liked_formats.required_proof_object: real manifest-backed document, map, or source photo with selective whole-word redaction
liked_formats.allowed_variation_range: change typography, crop, proof object, and color system by topic; keep no more than one variant per unique-topic set unless labeled A/B

liked_formats.owner_basis: Owner liked strong, clean, source-backed thumbnails with a clear dominant subject.
liked_formats.required_proof_object: dominant real building or street photo tied directly to the title-thumbnail promise
liked_formats.allowed_variation_range: new crop, poster depth, evidence tag, and color palette per topic

liked_formats.owner_basis: Owner wants map/source curiosity but rejects random arrows or decorative route marks.
do_not_use_cases: arrow does not identify a real route or boundary
liked_formats.required_proof_object: real map/route/source image with exactly one purpose-labeled highlight
liked_formats.allowed_variation_range: highlight only a real route, cut, boundary, or changed area

liked_formats.owner_basis: Owner rated the recent Cleveland city-and-proof examples 98/100.
do_not_use_cases: AI support presented as archival evidence
a dim or gloomy hero when a bright poster-grade grade is possible
generic text cards or small city labels
liked_formats.required_proof_object: one large, source-led historic photo or document frame tied directly to the promise; AI is only the vivid non-proof environment behind it
liked_formats.allowed_variation_range: vary hierarchy, palette, city scene, and proof-photo crop per hypothesis; preserve bright focal light, cobalt/azure plus warm-gold energy, dimensional premium type, and simple evidence-first composition

completion_boundary: This file stores owner preference rules. It does not replace owner review or performance data.
